children: HDFC Bank shares rose over 1 per cent on Monday, with the stock trading at ₹738.55 on the NSE at 11.14 am, against the previous close of ₹731. The stock hit an intraday high of ₹739.70. The shares were higher amid gains in the broader market, with HDFC Bank among the key stocks supporting the benchmark indices.
HDFC Bank shares recorded traded volumes of 116.28 lakh, while the traded value stood at ₹856.03 crore. The bank’s total market capitalisation stood at ₹11.39 lakh crore.
The adjusted price-to-earnings ratio stood at 14.06.
At the time of writing, the buy quantity stood at close to 28 per cent, at 11,07,714 units, while the sell quantity was at 72 per cent, or 28,88,185 units.

title: HDFC Bank shares rise over 1%, trading at day’s high
